brand.name: Git Game
brand.note: Working name; see docs/branding.md before changing.

notes: Source of truth for the tabletop deck. docs/design/base-rules.md describes the rules; this file describes the physical cards.
tabletop/build.py turns this file into the print-and-play PDF. Change this file, rebuild, commit both.
Commit and command cards are shuffled into ONE draw deck. Incidents, tickets and roles are separate small decks.

commit_cards.note: 60 cards, 12 bugs (20%). A bug is printed on the card face; only its holder sees it. Bugs sit on tempting sizes on purpose.

command_cards.name: git blame
command_cards.text: Flip one commit on main. If it holds a bug, its author takes -3 blame now. The commit stays face-up.

command_cards.name: git bisect
command_cards.text: Point at a range of main. If any bug is in it, its owner must say which half it is in. Halve until found, then flip it: -3 to its author.

command_cards.name: cherry-pick
command_cards.text: Copy one commit from main onto your local branch (use a spare card as the copy). The original author stays the author, including for blame.

command_cards.name: push --force
command_cards.text: Overwrite main with your local branch. Every commit after your pointer is erased and goes back to its owner's local branch. Take a Sin token.

command_cards.name: reflog
command_cards.text: Play at any time, even on someone else's turn, right after a push --force: the erased commits come back on top of main. Free to play.

command_cards.name: revert
command_cards.text: Choose a face-up bug on main. Put this card on top of it as a revert: it no longer counts as a bug at release. +1 for you.

command_cards.name: stash
command_cards.text: Set up to 3 cards from your hand aside, face down. They are safe from any discard effect. Take them back for free on a later turn.

command_cards.name: commit --amend
command_cards.text: Swap one card in your last unpushed commit with a card from your hand. On a commit that is already on main: +1 Sin.

command_cards.name: rebase -i
command_cards.text: Squash two or more of your unpushed commits into one. +2 lines for clean history. A bug found inside a squashed commit costs -5 instead of -3.

command_cards.name: checkout <sha>
command_cards.text: Target a player. They are in Detached HEAD: their next commit is discarded unless they first spend 1 op on git switch -c.

incidents.name: Friday Deploy
incidents.text: Everyone must push this round. Anyone who doesn't loses 1 op next round.

incidents.name: left-pad Unpublished
incidents.text: Every Dockerfile commit on main becomes a bug. Flip them face-up now.

incidents.name: Flaky CI
incidents.text: The next push this round rolls a die. On 1 or 2 it is rejected; the op is spent.

incidents.name: Standup Ran Long
incidents.text: Everyone has 2 ops this round instead of 3.

incidents.name: Security Audit
incidents.text: Going around the table, each player flips one commit on main that is not their own. Blame applies.

cards.name: Linear History Purist
cards.text: Finish the game with zero merge tokens.

cards.name: Owns Auth
cards.text: Have three auth.js commits on main at release.

cards.name: Release Manager
cards.text: Be the player who tags v1.0.

cards.name: Chaos Agent
cards.text: At release, each of your bugs on main scores +3 for you instead of -3.

cards.name: Documentation Hero
cards.text: Have three README.md commits on main at release.

cards.name: Small Batches
cards.text: Never make a commit with more than one card in it.

roles.name: The Intern
roles.text: Once per game, push without being up to date. Start with 2 extra cards. The first blame against you is ignored: they're learning.

roles.name: The Rebase Zealot
roles.text: pull --rebase costs you 1 op. Plain pull costs you 2.

roles.name: The Senior Reviewer
roles.text: Once per round, secretly peek at any face-down commit on main.

roles.name: The 10x Dev
roles.text: You have 4 ops per turn. Every commit you make must hold at least 3 cards.
